name: Climben Climbing Company
research_notes: Own Naver Place text: 'currently Korea's largest climbing / bouldering facility' with a tall bouldering zone and a rope-lead zone; day pass 20,000 KRW, hours listed. Own Instagram posting as of May 2026 (bio: weekdays 13:00-24:00, weekends 12:00-20:00). Own blog (blog.naver.com/climben) stops in Nov 2024, so the Instagram and the Naver Place listing are the live sources. Kakao pin 35.14683,126.91716 agrees (6 m).

name: Bawi Climbing Center
research_notes: Own Naver Place text: 'Gwangju's largest climbing centre, bouldering and also lead climbing'; keywords include 광주볼더링; 8 m lead wall mentioned in the trial-lesson text; day pass 20,000 KRW. Own blog posts on 2026-09-22 (Chuseok closure notice) and own Instagram posts to 2026-10-04. Kakao pin 35.14988,126.91982 agrees.

name: Red One Climbing
research_notes: Own Naver Place text: 'new bouldering problems every week and professional lessons' (owner is a former national-team athlete); price list and hours. Own blog active to 2026-09-16 (Cheomdan branch anniversary event) and has bouldering-party posts. The older Gwangju gym of the two Red One branches (opened 2020 per directory). Kakao pin agrees.

name: Red One Climbing Cheomdan
research_notes: Same owner text as the Nam-gu branch ('new bouldering problems every week'). Own Instagram bio gives the address and hours (weekdays 11:00-23:00); own blog 2026-09-16 announces the branch's first-anniversary event (so it opened around Sept 2025). Kakao pin identical.

name: Handwerk Climbing Jeondae
research_notes: Branch no. 1 of 3. Own Naver Place price list sells 'day use (lead + bouldering + auto-belay) 20,000' and 'day use (bouldering + auto-belay) 16,000'. Own blog (all branches) posts bouldering parties incl. '(26/02/13) Jeondae branch bouldering party' and was active on 2026-09-19. Kakao pin 35.17328,126.91391 agrees.

name: Handwerk Climbing Yangsan
research_notes: Branch no. 2 of 3. The branch's own pages do not spell out 'bouldering'; the evidence is the chain's own blog post (2026-06-17) about its quarterly member bouldering party, which links all three branch Instagram accounts and says schedules are posted at each branch. Directory (Spirit) describes this branch as having a Kilter board (third party, not counted). Kakao pin agrees.

name: Handwerk Climbing Bongseon
research_notes: Branch no. 3 of 3 (Naver Place text: '3rd branch Bongseon opened'). Chain blog evidence as for Yangsan; the branch Instagram profile was read as describing a bouldering gym (summarised by the fetch tool, bio not quoted verbatim). Related-name flags against the other Handwerk branches and Red One Climbing (Bongseon) are different gyms, 1-3 km apart.

name: Incave Climbing Sangmu
research_notes: Own blog has bouldering posts: 'Incave bouldering route-setting notice' (2025-02-10), '[Bolder Night vol.03] climbing competition report' (2025-10-07); latest blog post 2026-05-18, Instagram posts to Oct 2026. Opened 2024-02-07 (Gwangju News). Own Naver Place gives hours (weekdays 12:00-23:00, weekends 12:00-20:00), prices and directions. The bio and highlights themselves do not say 'bouldering'; bouldering rests on the own-blog posts. Kakao pin agrees.

name: Climb Lounge
research_notes: Open (Instagram posts Sept-Oct 2026; Naver Place hours and prices). The gym's own text never says bouldering: Naver Place sells a 'moon board pass' (10,000 KRW), the Instagram shows a pegboard/board wall, but the description and bio only say 'climbing centre'. Spirit (third party) calls it a clean gym with a moon board and spray wall. Bouldering left unknown (never assumed).

name: Bitgoeul Climbing Cheomdan
research_notes: Own Instagram account is @bit_climbing_boulder_ ('Bit Climbing Boulder Gwangju Cheomdan'; bio gives the address Imbangul-daero 785 B1, weekdays 14:00-22:00, Saturdays 12:00-19:00, Sundays closed), posts through 2026. Own blog posted a year-end promotion on 2025-12-19. Own Naver Place: price list, 40-min trial lesson. Bouldering rests on the account's own name; visitor reviews (not counted) mention both bouldering and endurance walls. Kakao lists the same address twice (an old 'Cheomdan Bitgoeul Indoor Rock Wall' entry, same phone 062-571-3332, no longer marked open): same gym.

name: On Climbing
research_notes: Own Naver Place lists prices and announced closures for 12 Oct and 26 Oct, so it is operating now; own Instagram posts Sept-Oct 2026. Bouldering rests on the own blog (blog.naver.com/onclimbing, stale since 2023: 'Oncle bouldering party' 2022-06-02, price/hours table 2022); the Instagram summary describes wall climbing and bouldering experiences. Hours: weekdays 13:30-23:00 (blog), Naver shows 14:00 opening. Kakao pin 35.19050,126.81801 (8 m).

name: Grabit Climbing
address: 광주광역시 광산구 임방울대로 507 올핀스빌딩 D동 B102호
research_notes: Open (Instagram posts to late Sept 2026; Naver Place announces a closure on 15 Oct). Opened about autumn 2024 in the former Climb Family Suwan space (third-party blog). The gym's own pages describe '220 pyeong, lessons, trials' and show a pegboard and spray wall in highlights but never say bouldering. Left unknown.

name: G1 Climbing Songjeong
research_notes: Own Naver Place: owner keywords include 볼더링 (bouldering); open-now status with 22:00 closing, 1-day pass 15,000 KRW, 1-day trial by booking. Own Instagram last post 2026-02-28 and own blog last post 2026-01-11 (promotion), i.e. quieter than the others: the evidence that it is still open is the live Naver Place listing (hours, prices, booking). Kakao pin agrees.

name: Hwang Pyeong-ju Climbing Class
research_notes: Training hall run by the first national-team coach: own Naver Place describes athlete training and lesson classes (lead, bouldering, speed) for athletes, hobbyists and rehabilitation; price is 'ask'. No day pass or public drop-in found. Own blog active to 2026-08-24. Access for the general public not established.

name: Gwangju Indoor Rock Wall
research_notes: Old club-style gym (Daum cafe 'GJCC' referenced by directories). Naver Place entry is unmanaged (no hours, 1 review). No own site or social found. Cannot confirm it exists today.

name: Sangmu Artificial Climbing Wall
research_notes: Listed on Kakao Map and in climbing directories (phone 062-381-3838). Looks like a municipal sports-park wall; no own site, no social, no Naver Place found. Nothing says it is open to the public or has bouldering.

name: OneClimb Suncheon
research_notes: Large gym (about 600 pyeong, opened 2023-07-01). Own Naver Place: owner keywords include 볼더링 and 리드클라이밍; its booking product is '2-hour trial: lead 50 min + rest 10 + bouldering 50 min'; price list; closures announced for 12, 19 and 26 Oct. Own Instagram (@one_climb_, hours Tue-Fri 13:00-22:00, Sat-Sun 10:00-19:00) posts to 2026-09-30. The Instagram @yeosuclimbinggym (also named 원클라임, #여수클라이밍짐, #순천원클라임) is related to this gym or the Yeosu gym (see kr-jn-004). Kakao pin agrees (12 m).

name: Carpe Climb
research_notes: In the Namak new town next to Mokpo (Muan county). Own Instagram bio: hours Tue-Sun 14:00-22:00, posts to 2026-08-23; own Naver Place: biweekly Monday closures, day pass 18,000 KRW. Bouldering rests on own-blog posts ('Carpe Climb bouldering party', 2022-08-29 and 2022-12-25) and Spirit's description as a bouldering gym (third party). Kakao pin agrees.

name: Mokpo Lead Climbing Center
research_notes: Own Naver Place: owner keywords are indoor wall, climbing, 볼더링, Climbing, Bouldering; open until 22:00, 1-day trial 15,000 KRW, monthly 100,000 KRW. Own blog active to 2026-08-03. Despite the name 'Lead Climbing Center' the only bouldering statement is the keyword list (single statement, no wall description found); owner may want a second look. Kakao pin agrees.

name: Yeosu Climbing Gym
research_notes: Yeosu's only gym found. Own Naver Place (day trial 25,000 KRW, a summer-holiday notice for 13-17 August without a year) shows nothing newer than 2024; its linked Instagram (@yuuuth_) is private; the Naver Band link was not readable. The Instagram @yeosuclimbinggym (named 원클라임, Suncheon number) uses the #여수클라이밍짐 tag, so the gym may have been taken over or rebranded. Spirit (third party, 2024) lists it as bouldering and open. Cannot confirm it is open in 2026; bouldering not stated by the gym.

name: Hwasun Rock Climbing Center
research_notes: Open (Naver Place lists a 9 Oct holiday closure; Instagram posts to Sept 2026). Describes 'indoor wall to natural rock', team and hobby classes; no statement of bouldering or a bouldering wall in the gym's own pages. Left unknown.

name: Mokpo International Sport Climbing Center
research_notes: Municipal competition venue (opened 2012; hosted the 13th Mokpo Mayor's Cup in June 2026): outdoor lead and speed walls, an indoor lead wall and, per directories (not primary), an indoor bouldering room added in 2023 with public hours Tue-Fri 14:00-22:00 (summer), weekends 10:00-18:00 and use by signed waiver. Its Daum cafe is the official channel but is script-rendered, so nothing could be read from it. Naver Place pin is the parcel (Okam-dong 636-5), the street address (Buju-ro 132-12) is from a directory. Public status and bouldering not confirmed from a primary source.

name: Spider Gym Yeosu
research_notes: Unmanaged Naver Place (no hours, keywords health club / kids climbing education, newest review 2020). Kakao links an old e-web site that no longer identifies a climbing gym. Looks like a former kids' climbing class or health club.

name: Palma Artificial Climbing Wall
research_notes: Facility inside Suncheon Palma stadium, unmanaged Naver Place (no hours, no reviews). Likely a municipal outdoor wall; nothing about access or bouldering.

name: Nepa Suncheon Climbing Center
research_notes: Old listing on Kakao (phone 061-727-8844, Daum cafe 'nepaclimbing'); no Naver Place and no social found. Cannot confirm it exists today.

name: Taki Indoor Rock Climbing
research_notes: Gwangyang's only listed indoor wall, a sports-facility listing on Kakao with no phone, site or social; no Naver Place found. Cannot confirm it exists today.
